numerical_claims.claim: EBIT before special items amounted to DKK 164 million, down from DKK 243 million in Q1 2024/25, resulting in an EBIT margin of 10.5%, a decrease of 5.6 percentage points.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: EBIT before special items (b.s.i.) was DKK 164m (DKK 243m), with an EBIT margin b.s.i. of 10.5% (16.1%).

numerical_claims.claim: The report notes that this margin was negatively impacted by tariff costs exceeding DKK 50 million and foreign exchange headwinds.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: EBIT margin b.s.i. of 10.5% (16.1%), the latter negatively impacted by tariff costs and FX headwind. Adjusting for tariff costs and FX, Ambu generated an EBIT margin of 15.2%... tariff costs amounting to more than DKK 50m.

numerical_claims.claim: However, adjusting for these external factors, the underlying EBIT margin was 15.2%, demonstrating continued operational leverage from organic growth.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Adjusting for tariff costs and FX, Ambu generated an EBIT margin of 15.2% in the quarter.

numerical_claims.claim: Operating expenses to revenue increased to 50.3% from 45.2% in the prior year, partly due to the inclusion of tariff costs and ongoing investments in commercial infrastructure to drive future growth.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: Gross margin declined slightly to 60.8% from 61.3%, primarily due to the high comparable gross margin in the previous year.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Gross margin in Q1 2025/26 was 60.8%, corresponding to a decline of 0.5%-pts, compared to Q1 2024/25... due to a high comparable gross margin in the same quarter last year.

numerical_claims.claim: Free cash flow before acquisitions totaled DKK 13 million, down from DKK 69 million in the prior year.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow from operating activities (CFFO) was DKK 106m (DKK 144m).
